description: This file manages notification sounds for a Mattermost web application, including sound mappings, options for user selection, and functions to play, loop, and stop notification sounds.

methods.name: getValueOfNotificationSoundsSelect
methods.description: Returns the selected notification sound option object based on the sound name.

methods.name: getValueOfIncomingCallSoundsSelect
methods.description: Returns the selected incoming call sound option object based on the sound name.

methods.name: ding
methods.description: Plays a notification sound if allowed and not recently played.

methods.name: tryNotificationSound
methods.description: Attempts to play a notification sound based on the provided name.

methods.name: ring
methods.description: Loops a notification sound to indicate an ongoing event.

methods.name: stopRing
methods.description: Stops the currently looping notification sound.

methods.name: tryNotificationRing
methods.description: Plays a notification ring that stops after a timeout or when paused.

methods.name: loopNotificationRing
methods.description: Creates and plays a looping notification sound.

methods.name: hasSoundOptions
methods.description: Checks if sound options are available based on user agent.

methods.name: convertDesktopSoundNotifyPropFromUserToDesktop
methods.description: Converts user notification desktop sound preference to channel desktop sound setting.
